label: Executive decision
title: Bring AI capacity into engineering
body:
A pilot of six weeks to reduce variable spending, retain sensitive context and maintain alternatives.

Local first.
Cloud when it adds value.

Scope: code, backend, UI and tests. Hybrid means local + cloud.

label: 01 / The problem
title: Per-token consumption changes the bill
body:
The team report points out users with spending of $2,000–10,000. We assume monthly amounts per professional here; verify against invoices.

US$ 10 thousand5 people × US$ 2 thousand/month
US$ 50 thousand5 people × US$ 10,000/month

This is not a market average. Cache, repeated context and parallel agents must appear in the baseline.
source: User-provided account · Arithmetic scenarios; no audited invoice

label: 05 / Architecture
title: Preserve context. Escalate according to policy.
body:
Repository + IDEIdentity and scope per project
↓
Local model + isolated toolsSearch, editing, testing and controlled logs
↓
Automated validation + reviewBuild, tests, contracts and UI

Authorised exceptions: the gateway minimizes context and calls the cloud. Data prohibited from leaving stays local.
source: Proposed architecture · fallback never replaces authorization to send data

label: 06 / Security
title: Controls outside the prompt
body:
Network and execution

Egress blocked by default, sandbox, least privilege and authenticated API.

Data and credentials

Secrets in the proxy/vault; indexes and logs with ACLs, retention and encryption.

Versions and supply chain

Pinned weights and runtimes, hashes, tested updates and rollback.

Physical environment

Hosts and accessories under management; dedicated infrastructure for greater sensitivity.
source: References: NVIDIA OpenShell · Google AICore

label: 06B / Agents and IDE
title: Keep the tools. Control the backend.
body:
InterfaceLocal Path
Oh My Pi / OpenCodeLocal providers + configurable permissions
Claude Code / Codex CLIOllama / explicit selection of local backend
Copilot CLI / VS CodeOwn endpoint / local models in chat

Qualify the harness with the same model, tests and policy. Permissive defaults must be reviewed; isolation and connection destinations are part of acceptance.
source: Sources: OMP · OpenCode · Claude · Codex · Copilot · VS Code

label: 07 / Side channels
title: Real risk requires a well-defined threat
body:
Research in Raspberry Pi, CPU and Llama 1B showed electromagnetic leak with probe and laboratory equipment.

It does not establish universal reading of Mac prompts from a meter away.

Response: physical control and workloads; evaluation of emissions for high sensitivity scenarios.
source: Alhalawani et al. · preprint and figure 3

label: 08 / Stability
title: Programmers’ reports inform the decision
body:
102issues encountered by specific search
3examined issues with preserved metadata

These are signals of user experience and operational risk. The search includes indirect mentions and duplicates; it does not measure incidence across the full user base.

There are recognized regressions from earlier versions. Intention to release datacenters remains a hypothesis, not a conclusion.
source: Sample and consultation in JSON · Report #63861 · Post-mortem April

label: 12 / Pilot
title: Six weeks, with criteria defined in advance
body:
1

Baseline

Invoices, tasks, quality and review

2

Implementation

Configuration, isolation and controls

3–5

Comparison

Real tasks, current flow versus hybrid

6

Decision

Savings, quality, security and capacity

Proposed targets: ≥30% total savings; ≤5 pp loss of acceptance; ≤10% increase in cycle; no exposure in defined tests.
source: Criteria for negotiation; these are not results already achieved

label: 13 / Recommendation
title: Buy evidence before scaling
body:
Approve the pilot, confirm the baseline and make the expansion result dependent.

Cost per accepted task.
Data governed by policy.
Versions under control.

Platform + Security + FinOps + Engineering/QA share the decision.
source: Next proposed step · no purchase, hiring or automatic publication
